Package de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix

Class Matrix

java.lang.Object
de.labathome.trustconstr.matrix.Matrix
Direct Known Subclasses:
DenseMatrix, SparseMatrix
public abstract class Matrix extends Object
Abstract dense/sparse matrix base. Two concrete subclasses:
  • DenseMatrix -- column-major double[] buffer; the BLAS and LAPACK kernels in LinAlg take DenseMatrix.data() directly with no copy.
  • SparseMatrix -- Dictionary-of-Keys; cheap incremental setAsDouble(double, long, long) plus SparseMatrix.toCSR() to materialise a CSRMatrix for compute.

The base class exposes only the operations both layouts must support: shape queries, element get/set, arithmetic, norms, slicing, scalar extraction, and an in-place fill/absInPlace. The fast paths (BLAS dgemm / dsyr / dsyr2, LU/QR/SVD/Cholesky via LAPACK) live on DenseMatrix and LinAlg.

    • isRowVector

      public boolean isRowVector()
      Lenient shape predicate: returns true if either dimension is 1 -- i.e. the matrix is shaped like a vector (row, column, or 1×1 scalar). Used by BFGS / SR1 / FullHessianUpdateStrategy as a shape precondition on their step / gradient inputs.
      Returns:
      true if either rows == 1 or cols == 1
